user_input: I want to sign up on your website, where do I start?
reference: Click the 'Sign Up' button in the top right corner of the website and follow the registration instructions.
source_questions: How can I create an account?

user_input: Do you take PayPal?
reference: Yes. Accepted payment methods for online orders are major credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal.
source_questions: What payment methods do you accept?

user_input: Where can I see the tracking info for my shipment?
reference: Log into your account and go to the 'Order History' section, where the tracking information is shown.
source_questions: How can I track my order?

user_input: How many days do I have to send something back for a full refund?
reference: Products can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, provided they are in original condition and packaging.
source_questions: What is your return policy?

user_input: My order hasn't shipped yet. Can I still cancel it?
reference: Yes, an order can be cancelled if it has not shipped yet. Contact customer support with your order details.
source_questions: Can I cancel my order?

user_input: How fast is express delivery compared to standard?
reference: Express shipping usually takes 1-2 business days, while standard shipping takes 3-5 business days.
source_questions: How long does shipping take?

user_input: Do you ship outside the country?
reference: Yes, but only to select countries. Availability and shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location.
source_questions: Do you offer international shipping?

user_input: My parcel arrived broken. What should I do?
reference: Contact customer support immediately. They will start an investigation and take steps to resolve the issue.
source_questions: What should I do if my package is lost or damaged?

user_input: I typed the wrong delivery address. Can it be fixed?
reference: Contact customer support as soon as possible. They will try to update the address if the order has not been shipped yet.
source_questions: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?

user_input: Can I phone in an order instead of using the site?
reference: No. Orders are not accepted by phone; they must be placed through the website.
source_questions: Can I order by phone?

user_input: Is my credit card information safe with you?
reference: Yes. Industry-standard encryption and strict security protocols are used to protect personal and payment details.
source_questions: Are my personal and payment details secure?

user_input: An item I bought went on sale 3 days later. Is there anything I can do?
reference: If the price drops within 7 days of purchase, a one-time price adjustment is available. Contact customer support with your order details.
source_questions: What is your price adjustment policy?

user_input: How do I earn rewards points?
reference: Join the loyalty program: you earn points on every purchase, and points can be redeemed for discounts on future orders.
source_questions: Do you have a loyalty program?

user_input: Can I check out as a guest?
reference: Yes, guest orders are allowed, though having an account adds benefits such as order tracking and easier future purchases.
source_questions: Can I order without creating an account?

user_input: Can I stack two promo codes on the same order?
reference: Usually only one promo code can be applied per order. It is entered in the designated field at checkout.
source_questions: Can I use multiple promo codes on a single order?

user_input: I received a different product than what I ordered.
reference: Contact customer support immediately. They will arrange for the correct item to be shipped and help with returning the wrong one.
source_questions: What should I do if I receive the wrong item?

user_input: Can I return something marked final sale?
reference: Final sale items are usually non-returnable and non-refundable. Check the product description or contact customer support to confirm eligibility for a specific item.
source_questions: Can I return a product if it was a final sale item?

user_input: I threw away the box. Can I still return the item?
reference: Original packaging is preferred, but you can still start a return without it. Contact customer support for guidance.
source_questions: Can I return a product if I no longer have the original packaging?

user_input: If I paid with a gift card and return the item, how do I get refunded?
reference: Returns are allowed, and the refund is issued as store credit or a new gift card.
source_questions: Can I return a product if it was purchased with a gift card?

user_input: I bought during a sale. How much do I get back if I return it?
reference: Returns are allowed, and the refund is based on the amount actually paid after the discount.
source_questions: Can I return a product if it was purchased during a sale or with a discount?

user_input: Can you engrave or personalize products for me?
reference: No. Custom orders and personalized products are not currently offered.
source_questions: Can I request a custom order or personalized product?

user_input: Can you hold an out-of-stock item for me?
reference: No, reservations are not offered for out-of-stock products. You can sign up for notifications to be alerted when it is available again.
source_questions: Can I request a product that is currently out of stock to be reserved for me?

user_input: If I order a pre-order item together with in-stock items, when does everything ship?
reference: Mixed orders are allowed, but the entire order ships only once all items are available.
source_questions: Can I order a product that is listed as 'pre-order' with other in-stock items?

user_input: Can I buy something that is backordered?
reference: Yes. Backordered products are temporarily out of stock but can still be ordered, and the order is fulfilled once the product is restocked.
source_questions: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'backordered'?

user_input: I forgot my password, how do I get back in?
reference: Click the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page and follow the instructions to reset it.
source_questions: How can I reset my password?

user_input: How do I stop receiving your marketing emails?
reference: Click the 'Unsubscribe' link at the bottom of any newsletter email, or update your preferences in your account settings.
source_questions: How do I unsubscribe from your newsletter?

user_input: How long is the warranty on your products?
reference: It varies by item. Check the product page for specific warranty information or contact customer support.
source_questions: What is the warranty on your products?

user_input: Are you hiring? How do I apply?
reference: Visit the Careers page to see current job openings and submit an application.
source_questions: How can I apply for a job at your company?

user_input: Can I see a live demo of a product before I buy?
reference: No, product demonstrations are not currently offered. Detailed descriptions, specifications, and customer reviews are available on the website.
source_questions: Can I request a product demonstration before making a purchase?

user_input: Will a sold-out limited edition item come back in stock?
reference: Probably not. Once a limited edition product sells out it may not be restocked, since these items are available for a limited time only.
source_questions: Can I request a product that is listed as 'limited edition' to be restocked?

user_input: Is there a chat option on the site?
reference: Yes, live chat is available during business hours. Use the chat icon in the bottom right corner of the website.
source_questions: Do you offer live chat support?

user_input: I bought something as a present. If it gets returned, where does the money go?
reference: Gift purchases can be returned, and the refund typically goes to the original payment method used for the purchase.
source_questions: Can I return a product if it was purchased as a gift?

user_input: Where do I write a review for something I bought?
reference: Go to the product page and click 'Write a Review', then share your feedback and rating.
source_questions: How can I leave a product review?

user_input: Is gift wrapping free?
reference: No. Gift wrapping is offered for an additional fee and can be added at checkout.
source_questions: Do you offer gift wrapping services?

user_input: I'm sending a gift to a friend in another country and want wrapping and a message. How does that work?
reference: At checkout you can enter the recipient's shipping address, add gift wrapping (for an additional fee), and add a personalized gift message. International delivery is only available to select countries, and availability and shipping costs are calculated at checkout.
source_questions: Can I order a product as a gift?
Do you offer gift wrapping services?
Can I add a gift message to my order?
Can I order a product for delivery to a different country?

user_input: My item arrived damaged and I want it replaced or returned. What's the process?
reference: Contact customer support immediately. They will guide you through the return and replacement (or repair) process.
source_questions: Can I return a product if it was damaged during shipping?
Can I request a product repair or replacement if it is damaged?
What should I do if my package is lost or damaged?

user_input: I used a discount code during a sale and now want to return the item. What will I be refunded?
reference: The return is allowed and the refund is calculated on the amount paid after the discount.
source_questions: Can I return a product if it was purchased with a discount code?
Can I return a product if it was purchased during a sale or with a discount?

user_input: I lost both the receipt and the original box. Can I still return my purchase?
reference: Possibly. Original packaging is preferred but a return can still be started without it, and a receipt is preferred (or usually required) but support may be able to help without one. Contact customer support for guidance.
source_questions: Can I return a product if I no longer have the original packaging?
Can I return a product without a receipt?
Can I return a product if I no longer have the original receipt?
notes: Knowledge base is slightly inconsistent about receipts ('usually required' vs 'we may be able to assist'). Good test of hedging.

user_input: Do I need an account to place an order and follow its delivery?
reference: No account is needed to order, since guest checkout is allowed. However, tracking is done by logging into your account and opening 'Order History', so an account gives you order tracking.
source_questions: Can I order without creating an account?
How can I track my order?
